description: Generator efficiency compares useful electrical output with mechanical input. Both energies refer to the same interval.
The motor receives the generator’s 150 J electrical output. Multiply by efficiency written as a decimal.
Use the original 200 J input as the denominator. Multiplying the component efficiencies gives the same result; adding their percentages does not.
The generator transfers 50 J and the motor 60 J into less useful forms such as thermal energy and sound. Energy is conserved even though useful output decreases.
